name: Workshop foundation — synthetic demo
quelle: Synthetic demo created for Challenge A

positionen.langtext: Excavate the workshop foundation pit and stockpile spoil on site. ATV DIN 18300 (2012-09), Bodenklasse 3–5.
Provide and operate a temporary pump as required. Confirm pump capacity, operating duration and discharge location before bidding.
Apply primer beneath the waterproofing membrane across the workshop slab footprint.
Install the waterproofing membrane across the workshop slab footprint.
Lay rigid insulation across the workshop slab footprint.
Lay the polyethylene separation sheet across the workshop slab footprint.
